blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.
blocks.zh: 编码机构的核查程序必须保存执行事实,解释其范围并履行检查义务。 我们通过合格的仓库检查、受控证据消费者和可执行工作流程来研究这些责任。 一项预期的13个任务要素研究发现,正确的报告事实不一定得出所要求的有限判决。 相反,在搁置的收据供应研究中,所有122个已交付的标签都是正确的,而16个答复误报了事实,另外11个超过授权范围。 生产维修供应成功控制,有限支持的保存故障. 在涉及31项任务的118起维修事件中,源干预将启动可达性与修复和证人生产与索赔业务分开。 寿命和资源控制划定通过验证确定的内容。 生成注释比较产生局部修复差异,但可以说明错误的解释;强而有力的普通基线、新任务和技能转让研究不能提供一致的整体优势。 这些结果说明了证据解释、适用性和已完成的行动的特点,同时限制了对一般诊断优势、技能恶化或所部署的折叠效应的声称。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: A coding agent validates changes by executing code from the repository it modifies. That production code may run discovery, command dispatch or output capture, or supply a test’s recorded events. Program comprehension therefore requires tracing the edit through validation to completion: did checking reach the intended operation, and did that operation produce the evidence used to claim completion?
blocks.zh: 一个编码代理通过从它修改的寄存器执行代码来验证更改. 该生产代码可以运行发现,命令发送或输出捕获,或者提供测试记录的事件. 因此,程序理解要求通过验证追踪编辑到完成:检查是否到达了预定的操作,而该操作是否提供了声称完成的证据?

blocks.en: Repair research distinguishes plausible from correct patches [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . We examine the path from a production edit through validation to completion. That path can change while test, assertion and runner remain unchanged. For example, adding flushing to write can satisfy a flush assertion while the requested explicit flush remains ineffective. Explaining this PASS requires identifying the witness’s origin.
blocks.zh: 修复研究与正确的补丁[29, 30, 31]有合理的区别。 我们从一个生产编辑到验证到完成的路径。 这条道路可以改变,而检验、断言和跑者保持不变。 例如,在写入时添加冲洗可以满足冲洗的断言,而请求的显式冲洗仍然无效. 解释这种PASS要求查明证人的原籍。

blocks.en: Moving specialist verification into a main loop and packaging procedures as Skills motivated this study. Anthropic recommends end-to-end migration evaluation [ 8 ] ; controlled comparisons find task-dependent coordination benefits [ 9 ] . Executable Code Knowledge binds code to contracts/evidence [ 14 ] ; Skill Runtime Intelligence reconstructs execution stages [ 15 ] ; compositional routing organizes retrieval/composition [ 16 ] . We ask what evidence establishes after production edits. The original repair cohorts do not identify folding or evolution effects. Exploratory handoff and Skill studies are retained in the supplement; neither is a core efficacy claim of this paper.
blocks.zh: 将专家核查纳入主要循环和包装程序,因为技能激励了这项研究。 Anthropic建议进行端到端的移民评估[8];可控比较发现依赖任务的协调效益[9]. 可执行代码 Knowledge将代码约束在合同/证据[14]; Skill Runtime Intelligence重建执行阶段[15]; 组成路由组织检索/组合[16]. 我们问,在制作编辑之后,哪些证据可以证实。 最初的修复组群无法识别折叠效应或演化效应. 补编中保留了探索性交接和技能研究;本文也并非核心效力主张。

blocks.en: We examine two interfaces in the same verification path: production code and runners generate observations; agents interpret those observations to report completion. RQ1 asks when factual observations support the reported finite judgment and completion scope. RQ2 asks which production/validation dependencies explain whether a finite result supports an operation-level claim. Source interventions address RQ2; generated-note comparisons test a separate practical consequence.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一核查路径上审查两个接口:生产代码和跑道生成观测结果;代理人解释这些观测结果以报告完成情况。 RQ1询问事实意见何时支持所报告的有限判决和完成范围。 RQ2询问哪些生产/验证依赖性解释有限结果是否支持业务一级索赔。 原始干预措施涉及RQ2;生成注释比较测试一个单独的实际结果。

blocks.en: Our contribution is an empirical account of production-to-validation dependencies, separating defect detection from explanations of the validation outcome. Three findings delimit it. Facts, verdicts and authorized completion differ: controlled interpretation assays separate them. Production code participates in validating its edits: reversions identify startup obstruction; witness, lifetime and admission controls separate executed work from the claimed operation or interval. Repair success does not certify its explanation: generated advice yields local differences while making unsupported claims. We distinguish task breadth from within-task interventions and compare practical consequences with ordinary diagnosis. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是对生产到认证依赖性的经验性说明,将缺陷检测与验证结果的解释区分开来. 三项结论对此进行了界定。 事实、判决和授权完成各有不同:有控制的解释分析将它们分开。 制作代码参与验证其编辑: 转录识别启动障碍; 证人,寿命和录入控制将已执行的工作与声称的操作或间隔分开. 修复成功不能证明它的解释:生成的建议在提出无根据的索赔时会产生当地差异。 我们把任务宽度与任务内干预区分开来,并将实际后果与一般诊断进行比较。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: II Study design
blocks.zh: 二. 研究设计

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Production code participates in both the behavior under test and the production of validation evidence. A candidate can obstruct startup or change which operation supplies a positive witness. The diagram organizes observable interfaces; it is not a model-internal causal graph or an automated integrity guarantee.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:生产代码既参与测试中的行为,也参与提供验证证据. 候选人可以阻碍启动或改变哪些行动提供了正面的见证。 该图组织可观察到的接口;它不是一个模型-内部因果图或自动完整性保证.

blocks.en: II-A Observable units and outcomes
blocks.zh: 二-A 可观察单位和成果

blocks.en: The unit of analysis is a repository task identified by its benchmark ID or public issue and frozen revision. Distinct IDs are not assumed to be random or statistically independent samples of all defects. Multiple conditions, seeds, source variants and repeated executions within a task are not independent task replications. We distinguish a requested check, actual target entry, its finite outcome, an emitted completion claim and broader behavioral adequacy. A runner error before entry is UNKNOWN , rather than a failing target assertion. For the production-repair cohorts, a finite-supported completion requires at least one accepted edit, a terminal finish/fixed action, a latest PASS receipt for each of the two named checks (changed and companion) bound to the final source digest, and PASS on both post-termination visible checks. Missing receipts, FAIL or UNKNOWN do not satisfy the predicate. Broader official checks and authored contracts are reported separately and do not retroactively replace this finite score.
blocks.zh: 分析单位是根据其基准ID或公共问题和冻结修订确定的存储器任务。 区别的ID不被认为是随机或统计上独立的所有缺陷样本. 一项任务中的多种条件、种子、源变体和重复处决不是独立的任务复制。 我们区分了所要求的检查、实际目标输入、其有限结果、排放的完成索赔和更广泛的行为充分性。 进入前的运行错误是UNKNOWN,而不是失败的目标断言. 对于生产-维修组,有限支持的完成需要至少一个接受的编辑,一个终端完成/固定动作,一个最新的PASS收据,每一份与最后来源文摘相连的两张命名的支票(更改的和附带的),以及PASS关于终止后可见的检查。 丢失的收据、短信息或UNKNOWN不能满足上游要求。 较广泛的官方检查和授权合同分别报告,不追溯性地取代这一有限分数。

blocks.en: Records bind revision, source/function identity, phase, registration/body observations, exits and errors. Entry means adapter invocation, not exhaustive coverage. Call stacks distinguish setup and body; file overlap alone does not establish startup execution.
blocks.zh: 记录绑定修订、来源/功能身份、阶段、登记/身体观察、出入口和错误。 条目是指适配器的引用,而不是详尽无遗的涵盖范围. 调用堆栈区分设置和正文;仅文件重叠不能建立启动执行.

blocks.en: II-B Evidence scope and diagnostic logic
blocks.zh: 二-B 证据范围和诊断逻辑

blocks.en: We describe a finite evidence item as ( h , c , p , o , w ) (h,c,p,o,w) : candidate source digest h h , selected check c c , observed phase p p , relevant operation o o , and recorded witness w w . This is an accounting convention rather than a new storage format. The selected check’s result remains authoritative only at its executed scope. Concurrent calls require invocation identity; a shared function name does not bind one receipt to every call. Three distinctions drive the analysis: 1. A requested check and a runner process are not evidence of target entry. We inspect whether the designated invocation and its required assertion-bearing function execute; pre-entry exceptions retain their own status. 2. A positive witness is not automatically evidence of the intended operation. We bind its observed producer and calling site, then use an operation-isolating consumer to test the behavioral consequence. 3. A modified validation context is a different experiment. Replacing startup production code may expose a candidate’s target behavior, but the resulting item is not evidence for ordinary execution under the candidate alone. These distinctions do not turn tracing into whole-program correctness. Original/official-fixed executions qualify the finite defect contrast and regression controls; candidate runs examine the repair. PASS/PASS preservation controls need not distinguish the original defect.
blocks.zh: 我们把有限的证据项目描述为(h、c、p、o、w)(h、c、p、o、w): 候选源摘要 h 、 选定的检查 c c 、 观测到的 p 、 相关操作 o , 以及记录的目击证人 w 。 这是一种会计惯例,而不是一种新的存储格式。 选中的检查结果仅在执行范围内才具有权威性。 同时位调需要引用身份;共享函数名不约束每个调用一个收件. 推动分析的有三个区别: 1. 所要求的检查和运行程序不是进入目标的证据。 我们检查指定援引及其所要求的具有断言的职能是否得到执行;入境前的例外保留其本身的地位。 2. 阳性证人不自动证明预定行动。 我们把被观测到的生产商和呼叫站点绑起来,然后用操作隔离的消费者来测试行为后果. 3. 修改后的验证背景是不同的试验。 取代启动制作代码可能会暴露候选人的目标行为,但由此产生的物品并不是仅在候选人领导下普通执行的证据. 这些区别并没有把追踪变成整个方案的正确性。 最初/官方规定的处决符合有限的缺陷对比和回归控制;候选人负责检查修复情况。 PASS/PASS 保存控制不需要区分原始缺陷.

blocks.en: A requested check and a runner process are not evidence of target entry. We inspect whether the designated invocation and its required assertion-bearing function execute; pre-entry exceptions retain their own status.
blocks.zh: 所要求的检查和运行程序不是目标输入的证据。 我们检查指定援引及其所要求的具有断言的职能是否得到执行;入境前的例外保留其本身的地位。

blocks.en: A positive witness is not automatically evidence of the intended operation. We bind its observed producer and calling site, then use an operation-isolating consumer to test the behavioral consequence.
blocks.zh: 阳性证人不能自动证明计划的行动。 我们把被观测到的生产商和呼叫站点绑起来,然后用操作隔离的消费者来测试行为后果.

blocks.en: A modified validation context is a different experiment. Replacing startup production code may expose a candidate’s target behavior, but the resulting item is not evidence for ordinary execution under the candidate alone.
blocks.zh: 修改后的验证上下文是不同的实验. 取代启动制作代码可能会暴露候选人的目标行为,但由此产生的物品并不是仅在候选人领导下普通执行的证据.

blocks.en: A reference contrast alone does not authorize a stronger requirement. Flush forwarding and polling progress come from the reported operations; warning extraction and relation ordering also have unchanged user tests or documented API behavior. Resetting observations, controlling object lifetime and scheduling mtimes are authored diagnostic contexts. They isolate those obligations but do not establish their deployment frequency. We treat annotated choice labels as an explicit application contract, not a universal API requirement. The optional-metadata experiment lacks evidence that its context is supported by Django and therefore supplies only a conditional behavior difference. The focused supplement records these bases and limits separately.
blocks.zh: 仅凭参考对比并不能使要求更有力。 Flush 转发和投票进展来自所报告的操作;警告提取和关系命令也有没有改变的用户测试或记录的API行为. 重置观测,控制对象寿命和调度 mtime 是作者的诊断语境. 它们孤立这些义务,但没有确定其部署频率。 我们把附加说明的选择标签视为明确的申请合同,而不是普遍的API要求. 选择性元数据实验缺乏其上下文得到Django支持的证据,因此只能提供有条件的行为差异. 重点补编分别记录这些依据和限制。

blocks.en: The source-level interventions are narrowly interpretable. A component reversion changes only a recorded fragment of an actual candidate, preserving the ordinary runner and checks. Its causal claim concerns that fragment on the exercised path. Startup-reference substitution changes the path’s implementation before restoring the candidate and must carry a conditional interpretation. Passive observation changes neither production source nor the check; outcome reproduction is a gate before interpreting its trace. A failed gate invalidates interpretation. Preservation is necessary, not sufficient: later agent-selected instrumentation preserves a visible result while reading an uninitialized variable. Source-level observation validity requires separate review.
blocks.zh: 来源一级的干预措施可作狭义的解释。 组件折返只改变已记录的实际候选人的片段,保留了普通的选手和检查。 其因果索赔涉及所走道路上的碎片。 启动参考替代在恢复候选人之前会改变路径,必须附带有条件的解释。 被动观察既不会改变生产来源,也不会改变检查结果;结果复制是解释其痕量前的一个门. 失败的门使解释无效 。 保存是必要的,但还不够:后期的代理选定仪器在读取未初始化的变量时保留了可见的结果. 来源一级观测的有效性需要单独审查。

blocks.en: II-C Sequential repair cohorts
blocks.zh: 系列维修组

blocks.en: Nine cohorts supply 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks (Table I ), using Qwen3-Coder-30B native FP8 and Devstral Small 2 24B on L20. Conditions within each cohort share tools, task facts, edit interfaces, per-stage limits and native checks. Study calls exclude synthetic transport fixtures. These are bounded repair workflows, not complete multi-agent reproductions. Exposed exploratory cohorts and later reservations remain separate; their outcomes do not estimate prevalence or a common effect.
blocks.zh: 9组为31项任务提供118次维修(表一),使用Qune3-Coder-30B本地FP8和Devstral Small 2 24B在L20上. 每个组内的条件共享工具,任务事实,编辑界面,每个阶段的限制和本土检查. 研究电话不包括合成运输装置。 这些是捆绑的修理工作流程,而不是完整的多代理复制. 暴露在外的探索性群体和后来的保留仍然是单独的;其结果并不估计普遍性或共同影响。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Actual repair cohorts. Entries are finite-supported completions for Qwen/Devstral; failures and non-completions remain in every denominator. Conditions differ across cohorts; E/F share four task IDs; H/I share three. Counts are not fractions.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:实际修理组。 条目是Qwen/Devstral的有限支持的完成;失败和未完成仍然存在于每个分母中. 各个组别的条件不同;E/F共用四个任务ID;H/I共用三个。 数非分数.

blocks.en: B varies ordinary/checklist/composed instructions; C adds archived-original startup traces. C’s input matching is confounded: two ordinary inputs that fit alone are rejected when paired with hypothetical longer inputs. Tokenizer reconstruction reproduces all four affected failures, withdrawing the efficacy inference. All endings remain counted; no Skill-composition/evolution effect is identified. The supplement retains budgets, native-call counts and failed histories.
blocks.zh: B不同普通/检查列表/组合指令;C添加了存档-原始启动痕迹. C的输入匹配令人困惑:两个单独匹配的普通输入在与假设更长的输入对齐时被拒绝. Tokenizer重建复制了所有四个受影响的失败,撤回了功效推论. 所有结局都计算在内;没有发现技能组合/演变效应。 补编保留了预算、本土计数和失败历史。

blocks.en: II-D New task qualification and controls
blocks.zh: II-D 新的任务资格和控制

blocks.en: Source hashes, reservations and exclusions precede actors. Syntax screens nominate mechanisms; original/official-fixed whole-function checks qualify finite defect and preservation contrasts. Five of nine initial reservations qualify, with setup failures retained. Passive traces reproduce 20 outcomes: only one of four changed-definition sets executes before target entry. Reference locations cannot certify candidate footprints.
blocks.zh: 行为者先于源头草率、保留和排除。 语法屏幕提名机制;原始/官方固定的全功能检查可以限定有限度的缺陷和保存对比. 在最初的9项保留中,有5项符合条件,但设置失败保留。 被动的痕迹复制了20个结果:在目标输入前只执行4个更改的定义集中的一个. 参比地点无法证明候选人的足迹。

blocks.en: Later qualifications retain three D tasks, four shared E/F tasks and six G tasks. Source-informed consumers freeze before actors. E has no finite-supported completion; F adds already-visible check source, jointly varying content and length. All five G completions pass prospective consumers; polling diagnosis is post hoc.
blocks.zh: 后来的资历保留了3个D级任务,4个共享E/F级任务和6个G级任务. 知情消费者在行为者之前冻结。 E没有有限支持的完成;F增加了已经可见的检查源,内容和长度共同不同. 所有5G的结业均通过预期的消费者;民意测验诊断是事后的。

blocks.en: A six-candidate screen retains Django16502, Pylint6506 and pytest11160 with three exclusions, following an unsuccessful mock-only screen and source exposure. WSGI iteration/closing [ 46 ] , command help and warning consumers qualify their defects. H/I reuse these tasks/models. Larger limits remove delivery failures but retain warning-only successes; broader unchanged tests reject all twelve endings without incremental consumer alerts. Full qualifications and failures remain in the supplement. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 在一次不成功的模拟独家屏幕和源头曝光后,一个六角屏保留了Django16502,Pylint6506和pytest11160三种排除功能. WSGI迭代/关闭 [46],指令帮助和警告消费者符合其缺陷. H/I重用这些任务/模型. 更大的限制消除了交付失败,但保留了仅警告的成功;更广泛的不变的测试拒绝所有十二个结尾,而无需增加消费者警报。 完整的资历和失败仍留在补编中。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: III RQ1: Facts, scope and completion judgments
blocks.zh: 三. RQ1:事实、范围和完成判决

blocks.en: The production analyses extend the registered study of evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled checking obligations. Two earlier controlled assays use archived reference receipts to score finite judgments and authorized scope, separately from the repair-completion predicate. Their complete conditions, failures and records are retained in the supplement and anonymous artifact.
blocks.zh: 制作分析扩大了对证据解释、适用性和履行核对义务的登记研究。 早先有控制的两次化验将存档参考收据用于记分有限判决和授权范围,与修复完成上游分开。 他们的完整条件,失败和记录保留在补充品和匿名文物中.

blocks.en: A prospective scope-by-rule study qualifies 25 checks on 13 of 16 reserved task blocks: 25 reporters and 400 consumers give 425 calls across four conditions, two models and two dependent seeds. In Qwen3’s broad/plain cell, factual fields are correct in 40/50 responses but verdicts in 32/50: eight recover the facts yet abstain incorrectly. Rule effects vary by model; low factual recovery in Qwen2.5 prevents treating its lower fact/verdict disagreement as reliable interpretation.
blocks.zh: 对16个保留任务区中的13个区块进行25次检查符合预期的逐条范围研究的条件:25名记者和400名消费者在4个条件、2个模型和2个依赖种子方面打了425次电话。 在Quen3的广义/平面单元中,事实领域在40/50的答复中是正确的,但在32/50的判决中是正确的:8项收回事实,但投弃权票是不正确的。 规则效果因模式而异;在Quen2.5中,事实恢复程度低,无法将其较低的事实/核实分歧视为可靠的解释。

blocks.en: A held-out assay crosses complete/missing receipts with issue text present/withheld on 16 checks in nine task blocks and two models. All 122 adapter-delivered labels are correct, but only 95/128 assigned outputs satisfy the joint fact-and-scope contract (Figure 2 ). Strict delivery is reported separately. Correct judgment alone therefore leaves an evidence-interpretation obligation.
blocks.zh: 在9个任务区块和2个型号的16张支票上,附有/持有一份被搁置的对照表,填写/丢失收据。 所有122个适配器交付的标签都是正确的,但只有95/128个指定产出符合联合事实和范围合同(图2)。 严格交付情况另行报告. 因此,只有正确的判决才有证据解释义务。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Receipt-supply output partition: 16 checks, nine task blocks and two models. All 122 delivered finite labels are correct, but only 95/128 assigned outputs meet the joint fact-and-scope contract. The 16 fact-error outputs may also overclaim; the 11 others have correct facts. Repeated cells are not independent tasks.

blocks.en: IV RQ2: Production-to-validation dependencies

blocks.en: IV-A Reachability: a Django command-dispatch dependency
blocks.zh: IV-A 可达性:Django指挥-部署依赖

blocks.en: In the six-task cohort, one Devstral composed ending claims a fix after two requested suites return UNKNOWN . Its production edit introduces an unimported name into call_command ; the runner also calls that function before reaching either selected test. Three Qwen endings on the same issue obstruct startup but finish unresolved. Thus there are four candidate endings on one issue, not four independent failures or four unsupported completions.
blocks.zh: 在6个任务组中,一个Devstral 由结束索赔组成,在两个要求的套房返回UNKNOWN之后,一个固定。 它的制作编辑将一个未导入的名称引入到 call_command 中; 运行者在达到任意一个选定的测试之前也会调用该函数 。 三个Quen在同一个问题上结束,阻碍启动,但完成未解决。 因此,有一个问题有四个候选人结束,而不是四个独立失败或四个没有支持的完成。

blocks.en: A phase-local diagnostic runs original, official-fixed and all four candidate sources under normal, sham and startup-reference modes. Normal and sham modes leave all candidates UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN. Substituting the original function only during startup, then restoring the candidate and aliases before setup/body, allows each candidate’s two target checks to execute and fail. Source and restored-function hashes bind all 36 outcomes. A serializer-only recovery and the earlier failed fingerprint audit remain in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 一个阶段局部诊断在正常的,假的和启动的参考模式下运行原始的,官方固定的和所有四个候选来源. 正常和虚假模式让所有候选人都留在UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN。 仅在启动期间替换原功能,然后在设置/机构之前恢复候选人和化名,使每个候选人的两个目标检查能够执行和失败. 源头和恢复功能的散列会约束所有36个结果。 只有序列器的恢复和早先的指纹审计失败,仍然保留在补编中.

blocks.en: The diagnostic answers a reachability question under changed startup context. It does not show that the unmodified candidate passes or even executes normally. A separately frozen synthetic falsifier makes this limitation concrete: a bootstrap-only fault yields normal UNKNOWN but startup-reference PASS, whereas an all-call fault yields normal UNKNOWN and startup-reference FAIL. These are constructed controls on the same issue, not new natural agent errors. A rescued PASS is therefore conditional diagnostic evidence, not a correctness certificate for ordinary execution.
blocks.zh: 诊断解答了在改变的启动上下文下的可达性问题. 它没有显示未经修改的候选人通常通过甚至执行。 一个单独冷冻的合成伪造器使这个限制混凝土:一个只带靴的断层产生正常的UNKNOWN,但启动参考PASS,而一个全称断层产生正常的UNKNOWN和启动参考FAIL。 这些都是对同一问题的既定控制,而不是新的天然剂错误。 因此,获救的PASS是有条件的诊断证据,而不是普通执行的正确性证明.

blocks.en: IV-B Reachability: an independent pytest obstruction
blocks.zh: 四-B 可达到性:独立的火烧障碍

blocks.en: In the five-task cohort, a Qwen dependency-condition edit on pytest5262 changes a neighboring safe_text_dupfile function and deletes its return value. The requested issue concerns the mode of EncodedFile . The edited neighboring function runs during pytest startup; its missing return produces a NoneType failure before either selected test. All four final checks are UNKNOWN. The actor does not claim completion, and a later request is blocked by the input ceiling. This is an independent repository issue, but not a second unsupported fixed claim or evidence that extra trace information caused the edit.
blocks.zh: 在五任务组中, pytest5262 上的 Quen 依赖条件编辑会更改邻里的安全_ text_dupfile 函数并删除其返回值 。 所要求的问题涉及编码文件的模式。 编辑的邻接函数在 pytest 启动时运行; 其缺失的返回在两个选中的测试之前产生 NoneType 失败 。 这四份最后检查都是联合国新闻网的 演员不主张完成,后期请求被输入上限阻断. 这是一个独立的寄存器问题,但不是第二个没有支持的固定主张或导致编辑的额外微量信息的证据.

blocks.en: We revert the two actual edit components independently and execute all four prequalified checks under the ordinary runner (Table II ). Restoring the return restores execution, exposing the original requested defect. Restoring only the mode leaves startup obstructed. Unlike startup-reference substitution, these are complete candidate variants executed normally. They establish the return deletion’s effect on the exercised startup path; they do not turn component variants into independent model attempts.
blocks.zh: 我们独立地恢复两个实际的编辑部分,并在普通跑车下执行所有四个资格预审检查(表二)。 恢复返回恢复执行,暴露了原请求的缺陷. 只恢复模式的启动受阻 。 与启动引用替代不同,这些是正常执行的完整的候选变体. 它们确定了返回删除对已启动路径的影响;它们不会将组件变体变成独立的模型尝试.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Pytest component reversions: one actual candidate, four whole-function checks.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:pytest组件折返:一个实际候选人,四个全功能检查.

blocks.en: Together these issues show why a production edit must be included in the dependency analysis of validation itself. One issue supplies an unsupported ending; the other supplies abstention/non-completion. Neither observation estimates how often this occurs across repositories. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些问题加在一起表明,为什么必须在验证本身的依赖性分析中纳入制作编辑。 一个问题提供了一个不支持的结束;其他的用品弃权/未完成。 两项观察都无法估计在储存库中发生这种情况的频率。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: IV-C Witness production: a finite-supported flush repair
blocks.zh: 证人生产:有限支持的冲洗修理

blocks.en: On Django13516, both Qwen conditions produce the same patch: add an unconditional underlying flush() to OutputWrapper.write() , while leaving explicit wrapper flush() ineffective. Both patches pass the canonical changed check and all prequalified additional official checks, and both actors claim a supported fix under the frozen finite predicate. They count as one independent issue and one distinct patch, not replicated independent discoveries. Both Devstral conditions instead implement a guarded explicit flush method and also pass the official checks.
blocks.zh: 在 Django13516 上,两个Quen 条件都产生相同的补丁:在 OptionWrapper.write () 上添加一个无条件的底盘(),同时保留明显的包装() 冲 无效 。 两个补丁都通过犬科变换的检查和所有经过资格预审的附加官方检查,两个演员都声称在被冻结的有限上游下有一个支持的补丁. 它们是一个独立的问题和一个独特的补丁,而不是重复独立的发现。 德夫斯特拉尔的两种条件都采用了防守明确的冲洗方法,也通过正式检查。

blocks.en: The minimal source distinction is the location of the underlying call. The Qwen candidate appends self._out.flush() to write ; the successful repairs instead supply a guarded explicit flush that forwards when the underlying output supports it. These are observed production edits, not faults injected for the experiment. In the unchanged fixture, the relevant action order is: stdout.write(’Working...’) stdout.flush() stdout.write(’OK’) assert underlying_flush.called This excerpt summarizes the recorded fixture order and final predicate; full original whole-function bytes remain in the artifact. The assertion does not reset the mock between writing and explicit flushing. Consequently, an earlier write-side event can satisfy it even when the explicit operation adds none. Our follow-up resets observations at that boundary, without demanding that writes obey a particular buffering policy.

' ) stdout.flush() stdout.write( 'OK ' ) 断言背后的_flush. 此节选总结了所记录的固定顺序和最后的上游;完整的原始全功能字节留在文物中. 该断言并不重置写作和明确冲洗之间的模拟. 因此,即使明确的操作没有增加任何内容,更早的写边事件也能满足. 我们的后续工作重述了在那条边界上的观察,而没有要求它遵守特定的缓冲政策。

blocks.en: The official fixture writes, explicitly flushes, then writes again; its assertion checks whether the underlying mock flush was called. Passive tracing of the unchanged check preserves all twelve original outcomes across original, official-fixed and four actual sources. The two Qwen witnesses arise from the writes surrounding the explicit flush. No underlying flush event originates at the fixture’s explicit-flush line. Official and both Devstral sources have an event from that line (Table III ). Thus the positive boolean alone does not identify which operation fulfilled the obligation.
blocks.zh: 官方写道,明确冲洗,然后再次写作;其断言检查了背后的模拟冲洗是否被称为. 被动追踪未变支票保留了所有12个原始结果,包括原始、官方固定和4个实际来源。 两个Quen的目击证人来自围绕明确冲浪的文字. 任何基础的冲洗事件都不会源于固定线。 官方来源和Devstral来源都从该行得到一个事件(表三)。 因此,单凭正布尔不能确定哪个行动履行了义务。

blocks.zh: 表三:一个问题的证据和行为模糊不清。 Quen 条件共享一个相同的补丁 。 明确事件归结于固定的冲线; 兼容性使用一个支持不冲程写入的输出对象 。

blocks.en: IV-D Behavioral consequence and counterexamples
blocks.zh: 四-D 行为后果和反实例

blocks.en: An operation-specific follow-up clears earlier flush observations after a write and then explicitly flushes. Both Qwen patches still fail to forward that operation; official and both Devstral repairs pass. A compatibility control uses a sink with write but no flush, supported by both original and official implementations. The new unconditional write-side call raises an exception for this previously valid output. The result is a concrete new regression, not a disagreement about eager versus lazy output formatting.
blocks.zh: 一个针对操作的跟踪在写完之后清除了较早的冲浪观察,然后明确冲浪. 两个Quen补丁仍未能转发该操作;官方和Devstral的修复通过. 一个兼容性控制使用一个有写但无冲浪的槽,由原始和官方执行支持. 新的无条件的写侧呼叫为这个先前有效的输出提出了例外. 结果是具体的新的倒退,而不是对急于和懒惰的产出格式的分歧。

blocks.en: The pre-outcome nested-wrapper consumer already distinguishes both Qwen patches from the successful Devstral repairs. Across all three consumer pairs, all twelve relevant actor endings are retained. The Devstral ordinary pytest ending passes its mode-directed consumer but fails the named official mode check and never claims a fix. This is an important counterexample: one consumer property also cannot replace whole-issue evidence. All four runserver endings fail their consumers without claiming completion.
blocks.zh: 出场前的筑巢-包装者消费者已经区分了两个Quen补丁和成功的Devstral修复. 在所有三对消费者中,所有12个相关的演员结局都被保留下来. Devstral普通的pytest结尾通过它模式引导的消费者,但失败了命名的官方模式检查,从不要求固定. 这是一个重要的反例:一个消费者财产也不能取代整个问题的证据。 所有四个运行服务器的结局都让消费者失望而未声称完成.

For a live wrapper over a flush-capable sink, reset prior observations after writing, invoke wrapper flush() , and require an underlying flush event within that call, before it returns. Earlier writes and later cleanup cannot satisfy this obligation. 2. Cleanup-context forwarding. When cleanup exercises the wrapper’s flush method on a flush-capable sink, that method forwards to the sink in that context. This is method-level evidence, not proof of timely explicit forwarding while the wrapper is live. 3. Write-only compatibility. A previously supported sink with write but no flush must still accept wrapper writes without an added flush-attribute exception. blocks.en: IV-E A lifecycle counterexample to callsite gating
blocks.zh: 四、E类 使用寿命周期反比喻,用于调用场地

blocks.en: The passive protocol predicted one total flush event for official and Devstral sources, but observed two: one from explicit fixture flush and another without its handler frame. We retain that failed prediction and separately freeze a 42-execution diagnostic: six unchanged production states, six command-fixture contexts and six canonical companion controls. The whole check and assertions stay unchanged; fixture variants preserve its required output marker. All twelve canonical outcomes reproduce the passive study, and every marker assertion remains satisfied.
blocks.zh: 被动协议为官方和Devstral源预言了一个总的冲浪事件,但观察到两个:一个来自明显的固定冲浪,另一个没有它的处理器框架. 我们保留了这种失败的预测,并单独冻结了42执行诊断:6个生产状态不变,6个指令固定背景和6个犬科辅助控制。 整个检查和断言保持不变;固定变体保留其所需的输出标记。 所有十二种犬科结果都照搬了被动研究,每个标记断言都仍然满意.

blocks.en: Table IV distinguishes the channels. Bypassing wrapper writes and omitting explicit flush still leaves one flush-method event for official and both Devstral repairs. Holding a strong reference to the wrapper removes that event and changes the same boolean assertion from PASS to FAIL. Retaining explicit flush while holding that reference preserves PASS. In contrast, Qwen’s two events depend on wrapper writes. These interventions locate a lifetime-sensitive witness channel in this runtime; they do not identify an exact C-level finalizer entry. Python documents that IOBase destruction calls close , which flushes the stream [ 36 ] ; this supports the lifecycle interpretation rather than proving the exact observed call chain.
blocks.zh: 表四对渠道进行了区分。 附带的包装工写和省略了明显的冲水,仍留下一个冲水方法事件,用于官方和Devstral修复. 强烈提及包装器可以消除事件,并将PASS的同样布尔断言改为FAIL. 在持有该参考物的同时保留明确的冲水保留了PASS. 然而, 这些干预措施在这个运行时间中找到一个终生敏感证人渠道;它们没有确定准确的C级最终确定器条目。 Python 文档, IOBase 破坏称为关闭, 它冲出流 [36]; 这支持生命周期解释, 而不是证明精确的观测到的呼叫链 。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Lifetime diagnostic on the same flush issue. P/F denotes the unchanged assertion outcome. Official and both Devstral states agree; identical Qwen patches agree. These are altered fixture contexts, not new repair episodes.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:关于同一冲浪问题的终身诊断. P/F表示不变的断言结果。 官方和德夫斯特拉尔两个州都同意;相同的Quen补丁也同意. 这些都是改变的固定环境,而不是新的修复事件。

blocks.en: Three questions must stay distinct. Callsite necessity asks whether removing the fixture’s explicit call changes the assertion. Event attribution asks which operation and context produced a recorded flush. Contract satisfaction asks whether that event meets the specified obligation. Cleanup can support cleanup-context forwarding even when the literal fixture call is unnecessary; it cannot discharge live explicit forwarding. The reset and write-only controls separately establish Qwen’s two failures. Literal-callsite gating is a deliberately overstrict rule examined here, not a rule attributed to prior methods.
blocks.zh: 三个问题必须区分开来。 Calliste问取消固定电话是否改变这一说法。 事件归属询问哪个操作和背景产生了一个记录的冲浪. 合同的满足要求询问该事件是否符合规定的义务。 清理即使不必要使用字面固定调用,也可以支持清理-文本转发;它不能解除直播的明文转发. 重设和只写控件分别确定了Quen的两个失败. 书写和调用是本文中有意审查的超严格规则,而不是由以前的方法决定的规则。

blocks.en: IV-F An independent task: snapshot evidence and polling progress
blocks.zh: 四至六岁 一项独立任务:概述证据和投票进展

blocks.en: Devstral’s Django11177 repair deduplicates snapshot_files , passes both named checks and its prospective real-file consumer, and finishes fixed. An additional thread-name check fails on both original and actual sources, identifying an uncovered obligation rather than a new regression. Snapshot cardinality, thread naming and polling progress are distinct properties.
blocks.zh: Devstral的Django11177修理破解了快照, 额外的线程名称检查在原始来源和实际来源上都失败,无法识别已发现的义务而不是新的回归. 截图要点、线索命名和投票进展是独特的属性。

blocks.en: A post-hoc consumer drives the actual StatReloader.tick , snapshot and retained-state code. Real-file mtimes are 100/101/102; controlled clock reads are 100.75/101.75/102.75/103.75. Only enumeration, sleep/clock and the notification boundary are replaced. Original, unchanged Qwen ending and actual Devstral source emit no notifications; the official repair emits 101 and 102. All sources pass timely-mtime and unchanged-file controls. This constructed coarse-mtime schedule is motivated by documented filesystem resolution limits [ 35 ] ; it measures neither deployment frequency nor process restart.
blocks.zh: 一个后热的消费者驱动 真正的Stat Reloader。 勾选、快照和保留状态代码。 实际存档时间为100/101/102;控制时钟为100.75/101.75/102.75/103.75。 只有点数,睡眠/时钟和通知边界被替换. 原文未变的Quen结束和实际的Devstral源没有发出通知;官方修理发出101和102。 所有来源都通过及时时间和未更改的文件控制。 这个构建的粗时表的动机是文件系统分辨率限制[35];它既不测量部署频率,也不测量进程重新启动。

blocks.en: The actual source registers a new path only if its mtime exceeds the previous wall clock. The first observation therefore never enters retained state in the main schedule. Whole-tick replacement restores progress. More narrowly, adding first-observation registration restores both notifications while preserving the comparisons and clock reads. Name-only and comment-sham changes do not (Table V ). Removing the registration recovers actual bytes.
blocks.zh: 实际源仅在时间超过先前的墙钟时才会注册新路径. 因此,第一次观察从未在主要时间表中进入保留状态。 全脚替换恢复进度. 更狭义地说,增加第一观察登记可以恢复两个通知,同时保留比较和时钟读取. 仅名和注释-sham的更改不在此列(表五)。 删除注册可恢复实际字节 。

blocks.en: TABLE V: One-task polling diagnosis. Notifications are observed on the constructed schedule; expected count 2. Snapshot/thread are unchanged official checks. Full-tick variants reproduce the corresponding registration outcomes; all 60 executions remain retained.
blocks.zh: 表五: 国家 一任务投票诊断. 在构建的时间表上注意到通知;预期数 2. 快照/行走是未变的官方检查。 完整的变式照搬了相应的登记结果;所有60例处决仍然保留。

blocks.en: The 42 full-source/component and 18 minimal registration/name/sham executions preserve all natural sources and controls. They separate an unrelated official failure from a residual polling defect on one successful ending. The earlier snapshot consumer’s PASS does not establish this downstream progress obligation; no general correctness claim follows.
blocks.zh: 42项全源/组成部分和18项最低限度的登记/姓名/假处决保留了所有自然来源和控制。 他们将一个无关的官方失败与一个圆满结束的剩余投票缺陷分开。 早先的即时消费者的PASS没有确定这种下游进度义务;随后没有提出一般的正确性索赔。

blocks.en: IV-G Evidence consumption: an independent regression
blocks.zh: 四-G 证据消耗:独立回归

blocks.en: On pytest11160, both model families replace issubclass(w.category, cls) with w.category is cls , pass their two visible checks and finish fixed. The larger-budget cohort repeats the identical patch. These four histories concern one task and one patch. Broader unchanged tests already reject it.
blocks.zh: 在pytest11160上,两个型号家族都替换为subclass(w. category, cls),以w. class为cls,通过两个可见的检查并完成固定. 预算较大的组重复相同的补丁 。 这四个历史涉及一个任务和一个补丁。 更宽泛的无变化测试已经拒绝了它。

blocks.en: The downstream user test emits a UserWarning and retrieves it through generic recwarn.pop() . Original and official-fixed sources pass; the actual patch fails retrieval. A diagnosis frozen after H source review but before I outcomes retains both references, all four histories and a comment sham (28 executions). Immediately before extraction, every state contains exactly one warning with the expected category and message. Generic extraction fails on every model history and sham; exact- UserWarning extraction passes throughout. Reverting the single predicate recovers original bytes.
blocks.zh: 下游用户测试发布用户警告,并通过通用rewarn.pop()检索. 原始和官方固定来源通过;实际补丁失败检索. 在H源审查之后,但在我得出结果之前,诊断被冻结,这四个历史和评论都保留了参考文献(28起处决)。 在提取前,每个州都包含一个精确的警告,包含预期的类别和消息. 通用提取失败于每个模型历史和假冒; 精确的用户警告提取通过整个过程。 恢复单上游恢复原字节.

blocks.en: This separates successful evidence capture from a modified consumer’s rejection of intact evidence. Failure occurs at extraction, before any queue-state assertion. The contrast explains an ordinary regression alert; it adds neither a defect-detection advantage nor a new subtype-bug category.
blocks.zh: 这就将成功的证据捕捉与修改后的消费者拒绝完整的证据区分开来。 失败发生在任何队列状态断言之前。 对比解释普通回归提示;既不增加缺陷检测优势,也不增加新的子类型bug类.

blocks.en: IV-H A primary-key fix changes documented relation ordering
blocks.zh: IV-H 主键固定更改已记录的关系定单

blocks.en: In cohort F, Qwen repairs descending inherited primary-key ordering and finishes with both requested suites and all six final checks passing. Its edit computes related-model ordering but deletes that expression’s return, falling through to the foreign-key column. Django’s documented relation-ordering contract still applies [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 在F组中,Quen修理由继承下来的主钥匙订购完成,同时有申请的套房和所有六张最后支票通过。 它的编辑会计算相关的型号顺序, 但删除表达式的返回, 并排到外键列上 。 Django有文件证明的关系订购合同仍然适用[44].

blocks.en: A post-hoc parent-link consumer separates key order from rating order: key1/rating1 versus key2/rating9. Original and official sources select key2; the actual repair selects key1, with SQL changing from rating DESC to relation-key ASC. Swapping ratings conceals the regression. Direct-ID and explicit-rating controls pass.
blocks.zh: 后浩克母链消费者将密钥顺序与评级顺序区分:密钥1/rating1对密钥2/rating9. 原始和官方来源选择键2;实际修复选择键1,SQL从评级DESC改为关系键ASC. 撕破的收视率掩盖了回归. 直接识别和明确评级的控制通过。

blocks.en: TABLE VI: Ordering-task source tradeoff. PK is the original discriminator; relation/direct are unchanged official tests. Natural PK outcomes are archived; component PK and all relation/direct outcomes are newly executed.
blocks.zh: 表六:订单-任务源交易. PK是原始歧视者;关系/直接是不变的官方测试. 自然PK结果存档;组件PK和所有关系/直接结果新执行.

blocks.en: Thirty executions retain all four E/F histories, both references and three component variants. Restoring the deleted return recovers relation ordering but reopens the primary-key defect; removing the new identity branches does not recover ordering. Restoring the return plus the official selective primary-key guard satisfies both covered obligations (Table VI ). AST bindings retain the actual edit’s components. Eighteen further executions show that unchanged upstream relation-ordering tests also detect the regression while direct-ID controls pass. The source intervention identifies the return’s role in this tradeoff, not the model’s reason for deleting it. Complete sources, consumers and counts remain in the focused supplement.
blocks.zh: 30处处决保留了全部4处E/F历史,包括参考文献和3个组成部分的变体。 恢复被删除的返回可以恢复关系命令,但重开主键缺陷;删除新的身份分支不能恢复命令. 恢复返回加上官方选择性主钥匙警卫履行这两项义务(表六)。 AST 绑定保留实际编辑组件 。 另有18起处决表明,上游关系排序测试没有改变,在直接ID控制通过的同时也检测到回归情况。 消息来源的干预确定了返回在这种权衡中的作用,而不是模式删除的理由。 完整的来源、消费者和计数仍属于重点补充。

blocks.en: IV-I Values and backend preconditions
blocks.zh: 四-一 价值和后端先决条件

blocks.en: On Django13315, DISTINCT repairs pass the selected checks yet change annotated-label choices from four entries to two, whereas original returns four: this is residual behavior, not a new regression. Real PostgreSQL point-field queries expose a separate equality-operator precondition already documented in the repair history [ 39 ] . The supplement retains all source states, SQL and scalar preservation controls.
blocks.zh: 在 Django13315 上, DISTINCT 修补通过选中的检查, 然而将附加注释的标签选择从 4 个条目改为 2 个, 而原返回 4 个: 这是剩余行为, 不是新的回归 。 真正的 PostgreSQL 点- field 查询暴露了在修复历史中已经记录到的一个单独的平等操作前提条件 [39]. 该补充保留了所有源状态,SQL和scalar保存控制.

blocks.en: IV-J Native C: allocation evidence depends on prior state
blocks.zh: IV-J 土著C:分配证据取决于先前的状况

blocks.en: On known zstd2094 [ 4 ] , a real C consumer checks correct decoding and zero configured-allocator requests during the call. Construction, initialization and warmup precede measurement. Five sources cross five contexts (25 calls, one issue, no agent repairs). Original, sham and reference-minus-condition decode an empty frame correctly but request four bytes on first use; after warmup, all pass with zero requests. Full reference and a condition-only transplant request zero in both contexts (Table VII ).
blocks.zh: 在已知的zstd2094 [4] 上,一个真正的C消费者检查在呼叫中正确解码和零配置分配器请求. 建筑、初始化和暖化先于测量。 五个来源跨越五个背景(25个呼叫,一个问题,没有代理修理). 原版,假版和参考-减号条件解码一个空框正确,但在第一次使用时请求四个字节;热身后,全部通过,请求为零. 完全参考和仅基于条件的移植请求在两种情况下都是零(表七).

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Configured decoder allocator bytes requested during each measured call. All shown decodes are correct. Constructor allocation is excluded; these are not whole-lifetime or physical-heap measurements.
blocks.zh: 表七: 国家 在每次测量呼叫中请求配置解码器分配符字节 。 所有显示的解码都正确 。 构造器分配被排除在外;这些不是全寿命或物理堆积的测量.

blocks.en: Allocation denial during measurement rejects the three old-condition cold decodes but preserves their warm decodes. Nonempty first-use controls also pass. Static-library/link-map bindings and unchanged source components support the contrast: warm evidence does not establish first-use behavior.
blocks.zh: 测量过程中的分配拒绝拒绝三种旧条件的冷解码,但保留其温解码. 非空先用控制也通过. 静态-library/link-map绑定和不变的源组件支持对比:温暖的证据不能确定第一使用行为.

blocks.en: IV-K Observation and execution boundaries
blocks.zh: 四-K 观察和执行边界

blocks.en: Additional qualified cases delimit the account. In Catch2 [ 1 ] , enabling successful-assertion reporting changes the same binary’s unexpected-throw exit from 1 to 0; sham agrees and the reference exits 1 in every mode (54 processes). Guava [ 2 ] exposes retained state despite a null presence query. These are known, source-informed dependencies, not independent discoveries.
blocks.zh: 其他有保留意见的案件划定了账户。 Catch2 [1] 中,允许成功反馈报告将同一二进制的意外抛出从1到0;sham同意,参考出口在每个模式(54个流程)中1。 Guava[2]不顾无效存在查询而曝光保留状态. 这些是已知的,来源知情的依赖性,而不是独立的发现.

blocks.en: An executable Superpowers helper [ 3 ] fixes one discovery glob while regressing the previously working prefixed form. Seventy-two helper executions and twelve direct npm controls separate discovery, attempted execution and body entry: missing npm can yield an “all tests clean” ending without entering either body. This is one artifact under authored failure-injection contexts, not learned-Skill degradation or failure with a properly installed runner. Full states and controls remain in the supplements. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 一个可执行的超能力帮助器 [3] 修正一个发现 glob ,同时递归先前工作前缀的形式. 72名协助处决者和12名直接npm控制单独的发现、企图处决和身体进入:缺失npm可以产生“所有测试干净”结束而不进入任何一具尸体。 这是在作者的失败注射背景下,而不是在正确安装了跑者的情况下学习技能退化或失败的一件文物. 补充材料中保留完整的状态和控制。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: IV-L Concurrent calls: settlement and input delivery
blocks.zh: 四-L 并行通话:结算和投入交付

blocks.en: A source-informed ADK replay [ 62 , 63 ] exercises real tool dispatch, asynchronous generators, queues and shutdown. Two same-name calls start; the base settles only the latest task and aliases their queues. Four native checks cover same-name shutdown, name-based stopping, a single call and distinct names. The pinned, unmerged proposed reference passes all four with cooperative tool generators; the SDK’s timeout does not guarantee settlement of uncooperative tools.
blocks.zh: 源头知情的ADK重播[62,63]进行真正的工具调度,同步生成,队列和关闭. 两个同名调用开始;基地只解决最新的任务,并别名他们的队列. 4次本土检查覆盖同名停机,基于名字的停机,单次呼叫和不同名称. 固定的、未合并的拟议参考文件通过所有四个工具生成器;SDK的超时不能保证不合作工具的解决。

blocks.en: Queue identity alone leaves a consumer obligation. An additional consumer exercises actual send_to_model broadcast and tool receives; a provider fixture only acknowledges native activity and tool-result messages. Base delivers one activity to only one same-name call; the proposed reference delivers it once to each. Single-call and distinct-name controls pass. A six-ending source-edit comparison (Section VII ) supplies the candidates. This consumer was frozen after that cohort completed but before inspecting its efficacy, and qualified before application to every final source. It does not replace the frozen primary score. None of the six actual candidate endings qualifies under either contract, so the extra check supplies no incremental alert on that candidate set; the source reversions below address a separate explanatory question.
blocks.zh: 排队身份本身就留下了消费者的义务. 额外的消费者练习实际发送_to_model广播和接收工具;提供者固定只承认本地活动和工具结果信息。 Base只提供一项活动给一个同名呼叫;拟议参考书目将每项活动交付一次。 单名和单名控制通过。 由六端源编辑的比较(第七节)提供候选人。 该消费者在完成该组工作之后,但在检查其功效之前就被冻结,并在向每个最终来源提出申请之前有资格。 它不会取代冰冻的初级分数。 6个实际终止的候选人没有一个符合任何一项合同的条件,因此额外支票没有就该候选人的一套合同提出递增的戒备;下文的源回转涉及一个单独的解释性问题。

blocks.en: Exact, reversible source edits isolate the dependencies (Table VIII ). Reverting only input broadcast preserves all four primary checks, yet loses one receiver. Reverting only shutdown bookkeeping preserves delivery to both but leaves a task pending. A comment sham preserves both. These 21 executions concern three authored variants on one reported issue, not new Agent attempts. Whole-file controls, including an incompatible registry reversion, remain in the supplement. The contrast separates invocation identity, settlement and actual input consumption; it establishes neither remote-model behavior nor migration of subagent reasoning into a main loop.
blocks.zh: 精确,可逆源编辑隔离依赖(表八). 只恢复输入广播保留了全部四个主检查,却失去了一个接收器. 仅恢复停业簿记会保留对两者的交付,但留下一项任务有待完成。 一种虚假的评论保留了两者。 这21次处决涉及一个报告问题的三个作者变体,而不是新的特工尝试。 完整文件控制,包括不兼容的登记册重置,仍在补编中。 对比将引用身份,结算和实际输入消耗区分开来;既不能确定远程模型行为,也不能将潜剂推理迁移到主循环中.

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Two same-name ADK calls. Four checks concern shutdown, stopping, single and distinct-name calls, respectively. Delivery measures one activity received by each invocation. Source variants remain within one issue.
blocks.zh: 表八:两个同名的ADK电话. 四次检查分别涉及停工、停工、单名和单名电话。 交付措施 每项援引收到的一项活动。 来源变体仍属于一个问题。

blocks.en: IV-M Task admission and shutdown in Rust
blocks.zh: IV-M 任务接收和关闭 Rust

blocks.en: Neon’s public BackgroundPurges change [ 47 , 48 ] supplies a Rust component replay. The intermediate version reads is_closed() , then later registers a filesystem purge. A hook pauses the spawner after its open-state read. Shutdown closes the tracker and returns with closed/empty both true, yet purging begins afterward. These facts do not establish the component’s stated completion guarantee.
blocks.zh: Neon的公众背景清洗改变[47,48] 提供了Rust组件重播. 中间版本读取为_closed(),然后登记一个文件系统清理。 钩子会在开口状态读完后暂停产卵. 关闭会关闭跟踪器,然后以闭/空返回,两者都是真实的,然而清扫开始之后. 这些事实不能证明该部分所说的完成保证。

blocks.en: The actual merged version reserves a task token before checking closure and retains it through the work. A one-line early-token control repairs the intermediate path while retaining its dispatch call. Both wait for cleanup; a comment sham preserves premature return. All four variants preserve normal purge, closed-request rejection, existing-work drain and dropped-waiter controls; two uninstrumented controls also pass. These 22 processes cover one reported race under a constructed legal interleaving, using the extracted component, native Tokio and real filesystem deletion. Full-server behavior and prevalence are unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 实际合并的版本在检查关闭前保留一个任务符,并通过工作保留. 单线早期控制器在保留其调度呼叫的同时修复中间路径. 两人都等待清理;一个虚假的评论保留了过早的返回. 所有四个变体都保留了正常的清洗,封闭请求拒绝,现有工作排水和投放等待器控制;两个无装置的控制也通过. 这22个过程涵盖一个报告种族,在一种已构建的法律交互作用下,使用提取的组件,原生的Tokio和真实的文件系统删除。 完全伺服器的行为和流行是没有衡量的.

blocks.en: V What the source-level explanations establish
blocks.zh: 五 源一级的解释确定

blocks.en: Ordinary errors already flag startup obstruction; broader unchanged tests detect the ordering and warning regressions. The additional question is explanatory: which dependency determines the observed behavior, and which competing account can be ruled out? Table IX summarizes contrasts from the completed cases, not predictions made on unseen repairs.
blocks.zh: 普通错误已经标出启动障碍; 更广泛的不变测试检测命令并警告回归 。 另外一个问题是解释:哪一种依赖决定了观察到的行为,哪一种相互竞争的账户可以排除? 表九总结了与已完成的个案的对比,而不是对未见的修理所作的预测。

blocks.en: TABLE IX: What ordinary checking detects and what the interventions additionally explain. Flush and flush-lifecycle rows concern the same issue. Every conclusion concerns the recorded source, checks and context; source variants are not independent repairs.
blocks.zh: 表格 九:什么是普通的检查发现,什么是干预进一步解释。 冲浪和冲浪寿命周期的排队也涉及同样的问题。 每个结论都涉及记录的来源、检查和上下文;来源的变体不是独立的修复。

blocks.en: Polling’s official failure and notification failure change independently; another failing test alone would not establish why. Inspecting the warning before extraction rules out failed capture despite an ordinary test alert. These are source-level explanations, not measured diagnosis-time or repair-success gains.
blocks.zh: 投票正式失败和通知失败是独立改变的;单靠另一个失败的检验并不能确定原因。 在提取前检查警告排除捕获失败,尽管有普通的测试提示. 这些是源一级的解释,不是衡量诊断时间或修复成功的成果。

blocks.en: Cleanup execution legitimately supports cleanup, but not timely live forwarding. A consumer PASS need not resolve the issue: a non-completing pytest repair passes the mode consumer but fails its named check. Rating alignment hides the ordering regression. No single signal yields an exhaustive taxonomy or universal gate.
blocks.zh: 清理执行合法支持清理,但不及时直播转发. 消费者的PASS不需要解决这个问题:不完成的pytest修补通过模式消费者,但未能通过其命名的检查. 评分对齐隐藏顺序回归 。 没有任何单一信号产生详尽无遗的分类学或通用门.

blocks.en: A C-library factorial extends the operation distinction: json-c lookup finds a decoded member, but assignment and deletion consume its encoded key differently. Setter-only decoding passes 144/144 assignment contexts but 4/12 removal contexts; removal-only decoding gives 36/144 and 12/12; combined decoding passes both. Original/comment-sham give 36/144 and 4/12. All five sources pass 28 upstream tests. These investigator interventions isolate two operations within one library, not autonomous repair gains or independent task replications; the supplement records source bindings and controls.
blocks.zh: 一个C-library因子扩展了操作区分:json-c查询找到一个解码成员,但指派和删除会以不同方式消耗其编码的密钥. 仅限解码通过 144/144 任务上下文,但有 4/12 移除上下文;仅限解码通过 36/144 和 12/12 ;合并解码通过两者。 原文/评论-sham给出36/144和4/12. 所有五个来源都通过了28项上游测试. 这些调查员的干预措施将两个业务隔离在一个图书馆内,而不是自动修复收益或独立的任务复制;补充文件记录源装订和控制。

blocks.en: An actual generated pugixml comparator separates three obligations: a successful sorting example, a valid comparison relation, and that relation matching current tree order. Its visible example passes, but an incremented counter makes both opposite comparisons true and non-repeatable; protected sorting crashes. Removing only the counter restores the exercised relation laws and removes the crash, yet only 8/28 moved-tree contexts pass. The official reference passes 28/28. Seven source states and 28 native processes bind this post-hoc intervention; it explains one actual repair, without establishing autonomous diagnostic benefit.
blocks.zh: 一个实际生成的 pugixml 参照器将三种义务分开:一个成功的排序例子,一个有效的比较关系,以及匹配当前树序的关系. 其可见的示例通过,但一个递增的计数器使相反的比较既真实又不可重复;受保护的排序崩溃. 仅删除计数器可以恢复已执行的关系法并删除崩溃,然而只有8/28的移树背景通过. 正式参考文件通过28/28。 7个来源州和28个本地程序将这种事后干预联系在一起;它解释了一项实际修复,但没有确定自主诊断福利。

blocks.en: We summarize the analyses with four questions: (1) what operation, preconditions, context and interval define the obligation; (2) what does the source-bound existing check actually establish; (3) which producer, consumer or retained-state intervention separates the competing explanations while preserving controls; and (4) is the result a residual defect, a new regression or only an altered-context difference? These questions organize retrospective case analysis. Prospective diagnostic superiority and gains over ordinary full-suite testing remain unestablished. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们以四个问题概括分析:(1) 哪些操作、先决条件、上下文和间隔界定了义务;(2) 以源为主的现有核对实际上确定了哪些内容;(3) 哪些生产者、消费者或保留国干预在保持控制的同时将相互竞争的解释分开;(4) 其结果是残余缺陷、新的回归还是只是文字上的改变? 这些问题组织追溯性案例分析。 预测性诊断优于普通的全包检验和增益仍未确定。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: VI Public scope calibration and successful controls
blocks.zh: 六 公共范围校准和成功控制

blocks.en: Two preselected SWE-agent submissions [ 18 ] supply twelve artifact/task slots: seven production-only patches qualify and five remain excluded. All 91 native executions and successful controls are retained. Django14315 passes PostgreSQL-subclass checks while the inherited client contract fails. Django15252 passes mocked caller routing while real migration checks fail. Their four public reports already say unresolved: these are scope explanations, not new evaluator false positives. Django16116 and Pylint6528 pass all selected checks; pytest5840 preserves five controls but fails its defect discriminator. Django13112 has an ordinary syntax obstruction. The supplement retains every slot and exclusion.
blocks.zh: 预选的SWE代理提交书2份[18]提供12件文物/任务槽:7件只生产补丁合格,5件仍排除在外. 所有91起本地处决和成功控制被保留。 Django14315在继承客户合同失败时通过PostgreSQL子类检查. Django15252的通行证在真正的移民检查失败时,嘲弄了打电话者的路线。 他们的四份公开报告已经说还没有解决:这些是范围解释,不是新的评价员的虚假阳性. Django16116和Pylint6528通过所有选定的检查;pytest5840保留了5个控制,但未能通过它的缺陷歧视者. Django13112有一个普通的语法障碍. 补编保留了每个档次和排除。

blocks.en: A separate stream of 2,283 predictions for 2,266 tasks yields 35 syntactic stand-in nominations; five source-informed cases qualify. Frozen scripts pass on original, reference, candidate and comment-sham sources, but real obligations pass only with the reference; preservation controls pass throughout (45 PASS/15 FAIL/0 UNKNOWN). Sphinx10481 and Django14559 voluntarily submit after simulation success. Three other actors end at their budget limit. Crucially, Django15666 imports actual Django and enters ORM representation, but mocked fetching supplies the cache without executing the required SQL-ordering compiler. This rules out import or incidental entry as sufficient evidence. Direct real checks also reject all five candidates, so no superiority to that baseline follows. These added-script cases are separate from the production-only cohorts. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 对2 266项任务进行2 283次单独预测,可产生35项综合提名;5个来源信息案例符合资格。 冻结的脚本传递原始、参考、候选和评论-sham来源,但实际义务仅随参考而通过;保存控制贯穿全过程(45 PAS/15 FAIL/0 UNKNOWN)。 Sphinx10481和Django14559在模拟成功后自愿提交. 另有3个行动者在预算限额内结束。 关键是,Django15666进口了实际的Django,并进入ORM代理,但嘲讽在未执行所需的SQL订购编译器的情况下获取缓存供应. 这排除了进口或附带输入作为充分证据的可能性。 直接的真正检查也拒绝所有5名候选人,因此,不优于这一基线。 这些附加说明的案件与只生产组别分开。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: VII Secondary test: generated advice and repair
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 二级测试:提供建议和维修

blocks.en: Our main contribution is the source-level analysis of validation dependencies. We separately test whether generated interpretation helps repair: explanation accuracy, repair success and evidence scope are different outcomes. All comparisons below are exploratory; repeated seeds and contexts do not increase the independent task count. The benefit supplement retains the complete earlier comparisons, failures and costs, including handoff and Skill studies.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是对验证依赖性的源层次分析. 我们分别检验生成的解释是否有助于修复:解释准确性,修复成功和证据范围是不同的结果. 下面的所有比较都是探索性的;重复的种子和上下文不会增加独立的任务计数. 津贴补贴保留了早期的完整比较、失败和成本,包括发放和技能研究。

blocks.en: Across three new C/C++/Rust tasks, fresh ordinary and operation-specific notes each repair 0/3 versus withholding 1/3. A later equal-input-length re-audit yields operation 1/6, ordinary 2/6 and withholding 0/6 across two seeds. Supplying all six actual helpers per task, notes and visible feedback equally yields 2/3 for ordinary integration analysis, operation analysis and no extra analysis. These contrary results prevent interpreting added analysis as a general repair improvement.
blocks.zh: 跨越三个新的C/C++/ 粗糙的任务,新鲜的普通和具体操作的笔记 每一个修复0/3相对于扣1/3。 稍后的等效输入长的再审计操作为1/6,普通2/6,并在两个种子上扣0.6. 每个任务、说明和可见反馈提供所有6名实际帮助者,均能产生2/3的普通综合分析、操作分析以及无额外分析。 这些相反的结果阻碍了将附加分析解释为一般的修复改进。

blocks.en: An agent-selected trace workflow first produces no usable final plan. Mechanical recovery and source auditing remove invalid watches, including pre-initializer reads that preserved visible output. Two fixed seeds then yield trace-plus-generated-note 2/6 versus 0/6 for source-only, raw-trace and trace-withheld-note controls under equal initial repair lengths. Both gains are Rust, passing 112 checks in each build; C/C++ remain unrepaired. A new nlohmann/json task [ 58 ] yields ordinary and operation notes 2/2 successful seeds versus withholding 1/2, each success passing 32 contexts. The notes incorrectly blame the returned iterator: a separate replay finds original iterator equality 32/32 while array equality is 20/32. Thus repair success does not validate every statement in a diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 代理人选定的跟踪工作流程首先不会产生有用的最终计划。 机械恢复和源头审计删除无效的手表,包括预初始器读取保留可见输出的手表. 然后,两个固定种子在相同的初始修复长度下,对纯源、原始跟踪和带痕的记号控制产生痕量加生成的记号2/6,对0/6。 两项增益均为Rust,每座建筑通过112次检查;C/C++仍未修复. 一项新的nlohmann/json任务[58]产生普通,操作说明2/2成功种子与扣1/2成功,每次成功都通过32个背景. 注释错误地指责了返回的执行者:一个单独的重播会发现原始执行者平等 32/32,而阵列平等是20/32. 因此,修复成功并不能证实诊断中的每一句话。

blocks.en: TABLE X: Content ablation on two adaptively selected tasks, each with two repair seeds. Four existing Agent-generated notes are reused. Replay preserves generated code and changes only extraction; it is not a rerun of the interaction.
blocks.zh: 表十:内容对两个适应性选择的任务进行删减,每个任务都有两个修补种子. 现有4个代理生成的笔记被重新使用. 重放保存生成的代码, 只更改提取; 它不是交互的重播 。

blocks.en: A two-task component ablation transfers either each actual note, its exact compatible-repair section, or no note, with matched initial lengths and two fresh repair seeds (Table X ). Uniform exact-code recovery scans all 24 responses and replays all four marker-rejected functions. The section-only advantage survives this sensitivity analysis. However, both tasks were selected after earlier local gains; notes were reused rather than freshly generated. Removing four sections jointly changes salience, potentially misleading information and presentation. This experiment identifies a local content-transfer effect, not why it occurs or whether explanatory reasoning is necessary.
blocks.zh: 双任务组件切换或每个实际的音符,其精确的兼容修复部分,或无音符,并配有对应的初始长度和两个新鲜的修复种子(表X). 统一精确代码回收扫描所有24个响应,并重放所有四个被标记拒绝的功能. 仅分科的优势在这种敏感度分析中幸存. 然而,这两项任务都是在较早的地方收益之后选定的;纸币被重新使用,而不是重新生成。 删除四节将共同改变突出之处,可能误导信息和列报方式。 这一实验确定了本地内容转移效应,而不是其发生的原因或解释性推理是否必要。

blocks.en: Fresh more-itertools notes [ 59 ] yield no repair in six endings on 39 contexts; an exposed repeat also fails all six. Scoped notes confuse reverse with positive slicing. Cachetools supplies no full repair. Boltons [ 60 ] initially favors scoped notes, but a fixed three-seed replication reverses the complete-note direction; uniform source recovery equalizes it at 2/3. Bidict [ 61 ] rejects all eight primary endings; three reach 38/39 while breaking ordinary equality. These trials limit the selected-task contrast. Full per-condition outcomes, failed histories, source-recovery rules and costs remain in the benefit supplement.
blocks.zh: 新鲜的更尖端工具说明[59]在39个上下文的6个结尾中不进行修复;一个暴露的重复也全部六处失败. 范围说明将反向与正切片混淆。 缓存工具提供不完全维修. Boltons [60] 最初倾向于范围化的音符,但固定的三种子复制反转了完整的音符方向;统一源恢复等于2/3. Bodit [61] 拒绝所有八个主要结局;三个在打破普通平等的同时达到38/39. 这些试验限制了所选任务对比. 福利补贴中保留了所有有条件的结果、失败的历史、来源回收规则和费用。

blocks.en: Four previously unused tasks in attrs (Python), cJSON (C), Gson (Java) and SmallVec (Rust) supply a frozen comparison with two seeds per task. Each arm generates its own explanation, selects one authored candidate for three native checks, then selects a candidate and predicts all nine candidate/check outcomes. Initial input lengths, model-call and output ceilings match. Ordinary/scoped procedures both select the qualified candidate in 6/8 endings, but satisfy the joint choice-and-prediction contract in 3/8 versus 0/8. All sixteen final JSON outputs are valid; each arm has one invalid first-stage probe selection. Four SmallVec outputs contradict their own executed receipt, two per arm. These constrained decisions provide fresh counterevidence to diagnostic superiority, not autonomous repairs. A development follow-up retains all sixteen endings: automatic receipt-conflict feedback and strong ordinary second review both satisfy the joint contract in 6/16 revisions. Feedback reduces receipt contradictions but leaves one malformed output and no overall diagnostic gain. Full inputs, controls, costs and limitations are in the supplementary update.
blocks.zh: 4个先前未使用的任务在Attrs(Python),cJSON(C),Gson(Java)和SmallVec(Rust)中提供了每任务2个种子的冷冻比较. 每个臂产生自己的解释,选择一名作者候选人进行三次本土检查,然后选择一名候选人并预测所有9名候选人/检查结果. 初始输入长度,模式调用和输出上限匹配. 普通/范围程序都以6/8结尾选择合格候选人,但在3/8对0/8中满足了联合选择和预测合同。 JSON的所有16个最终输出都是有效的;每个臂有一个无效的第一阶段探测器选择. 4个SmallVec产出与它们自己执行的收据相矛盾,每个臂2个. 这些受制约的决定为诊断优势提供了新的反证,而不是自主修复. 一项发展后续行动保留了所有16个结束:自动收到冲突反馈和有力的普通第二次审查都满足了6/16修订中的联合合同。 反馈会减少接收的矛盾,但留下一个错误的输出,没有总体的诊断收益. 全部投入、控制、成本和限制都在补充更新中。

blocks.en: Two navigation workflows share a fresh Agent-generated probe and receipt across newly generated ordinary-note, operation-note and no-note conditions. Six four-file ADK endings yield 0/2 full source passes per arm under matched 12-decision/12-process ceilings. Eighteen endings across ADK cancellation, Tenacity iteration and AnyIO process close yield 2/6,1/6 and 0/6 under matched six-decision/12-process ceilings; all successes concern ADK cancellation. None delivers a finish action, and 14/24 leave source unchanged. Source-pass endpoints differ from the original completion predicate.
blocks.zh: 两个导航工作流程共享一个新的Agent生成的探针和接收,跨越新生成的普通注,操作注和无注条件. 六个四个文件的ADK末端在12号决定/12流程的上限下,每只臂产生0/2的全源通行证。 ADK取消、Tenacity迭代和AnyIO进程在6项第12号决定-进程上限下共18个结束;所有成功都涉及ADK的取消。 无一能完成行动,14/24则使来源保持不变。 源-通过端点与最初的完成上游不同.

blocks.en: Mandatory-proposal interfaces separate navigation from edit opportunity. Twelve exposed-task endings produce no applicable exact-string edit. A frozen line-span workflow on process close and an unused memory-stream issue [ 49 ] accepts all 48 proposals and changes 20/24 final sources, but each arm scores 0/8. A second-model repeat accepts 22/24 proposals with each arm at 0/4. Active, method-specific source interventions and probes, expanded edit closure and mechanical multiline decoding accept 14/16 diagnostic edits and 23/24 repair proposals, yet again yield 0/4 per arm. An HTTPcore transfer also yields 0/2 per arm, with heavy diagnostic truncation. Interface-limited histories and complete costs remain in the supplement; these dependent development trials establish no explanation advantage and are not pooled.
blocks.zh: 强制-建议接口将导航与编辑机会分开. 12个曝光任务结尾不产生适用的精确字符串编辑。 程序关闭时冻结的行宽工作流程和一个未使用的内存流问题[49]接受全部48个提案,并更改20/24最终来源,但每个臂都得0/8分. 第二型重复在0/4时接受22/24提案,每个臂都接受. 主动的,针对方法的源干预和探针,扩大编辑关闭和机械多线解码接受14/16诊断编辑和23/24修复建议,再次获得每臂0/4. HTTPcore转录也产生每只手臂0/2分,重度诊断截断. 界面有限的历史和全部费用仍留在补编中;这些依赖的发展试验没有建立解释优势,也没有汇集起来。

blocks.en: The benefit supplement retains local gains, null results and contrary Skill transfer. Different endpoints and task pools preclude pooling; no deployed-folding or general Skill-evolution gain is established. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 津贴补贴保留当地收益、无效结果和相反的技能转让。 不同的终点和任务集合排除了集合;没有确定部署的重复或一般技能演变收益。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: VIII Relation to prior work
blocks.zh: 八. 与以前工作的关系

blocks.en: VeriSkill attributes verification failures, abstracts lessons and admits Skill revisions through executable validation while preserving the original executable program [ 17 ] . We study changes to production behavior that also participates in validation. Our prediction and online-Skill experiments use different endpoints and do not implement VeriSkill’s admission method. SkillEvolBench separates experience reuse from Skill formation through frozen transfer [ 53 ] ; SkillEvoReg uses perturbations and paired candidate-conditioned counterexamples [ 54 ] . Counterexample admission is therefore prior work.
blocks.zh: VeriSkill 属性验证失败,摘要课和通过可执行验证承认Skill修订,同时保留原始可执行程序 [17]. 我们研究生产行为的变化 也参与验证。 我们的预测和在线技能实验使用不同的终点,不采用VeriSkill的录取方法。 SkillEvol Bench通过冷冻转移将经验再利用与技能形成分离[53]; Skill EvoReg使用扰动和配对的候选条件反例[54]. 因此,反证录取是前期工作。

blocks.en: Trace-augmented repair and probing are established: Haque et al. report configuration-dependent gains [ 56 ] ; TraceRepair combines probes and repair perspectives [ 57 ] . Our shared-observation controls test added interpretation, without reproducing or outperforming these systems.
blocks.zh: 追踪修复和探测工作得到确立: Haque等人著. ; TraceRepair将探测器与修复视角结合起来 [57] 。 我们的共享观测控制测试 附加解释, 不复制或超过这些系统。

blocks.en: ECK binds code to contracts, evidence, provenance and freshness [ 14 ] ; ContextProof versions source and dependencies [ 43 ] . Both can represent stronger checks. Our contrasts concern which operation, context and interval an observation supports. Source-bound guidance is an inspired condition, not an ECK reproduction.
blocks.zh: ECK对合同、证据、出处和新鲜度的编码具有约束力[14]; Proof版本的来源和依赖性[43]。 两者都可以代表更强有力的检查。 与此形成对比的是,我们所担心的是,哪些行动、背景和间隔观测得到支持。 源头式指导是一种启发性条件,而不是ECK复制.

blocks.en: SkillsVote and AgentFactory govern Skill evolution and executable subagents [ 10 , 11 ] . BRIDGE studies provenance/counterfactual handoff repair and HSC-Bench state-dependent continuation [ 12 , 13 ] ; CTA, SkillTriage and Agent Skill Evolution examine trajectories, attribution and revisions [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Our delivered revisions show no observed behavioral-transfer advantage, and fixed-checkpoint results do not identify deployed folding effects.
blocks.zh: 技能之声和代理 技能进化与可执行子剂 [10, 11]. BRIDEGE研究出处/反事实交接修理和HSC-Bench状态依赖续作[12,13];CTA,SkillTriage和Agent Skill Evolution审查轨迹,归属和修订[5,6,7]. 我们交付的修订显示,没有观察到行为转移优势,固定检查点结果无法识别已部署的折叠效果。

blocks.en: Whose Oracle Is It? protects acceptance-witness dependencies while excluding production behavior under repair [ 21 ] . Our command-dispatch cases place production code in both startup and target roles; substituting startup gives conditional evidence. BSG-VA binds commands to source states and replays bug contrasts [ 25 ] ; our equal-triple counterexample does not refute its richer method. SWE-Doctor diagnoses pre-target failure and partial repair [ 22 ] . Building to the Test ablates unintended behavior suppliers [ 23 ] ; our lifetime controls distinguish cleanup from live forwarding. Veritas and The Verification Horizon examine branch dependence and verifier faithfulness [ 45 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 谁是甲骨文? 保护接受-证人依赖性,同时排除正在修复的生产行为[21]. 我们的指令发布案例将生产代码放在启动和目标角色中;替代启动给出了有条件的证据. BSG-VA将命令绑定到源状态,并重放bug对比[25];我们的等三反例并不反驳它更丰富的方法. SWE-医生诊断预目标故障及部分修复[22]. "测试"的建设让意外行为供应商退缩 [23];我们一生的控制将清理与直播转发区分开来. Veritas和核查地平线审查分支的依赖性和核查的可靠性[45、24]。

blocks.en: Existing audits examine mocks, replay and phase integrity [ 19 , 33 , 34 , 38 , 37 ] , test-writing frequency [ 20 ] , verifier restrictions [ 26 ] , harnesses [ 28 , 27 ] , patch–issue alignment [ 51 ] , test validity/detection [ 52 ] and amplification [ 55 ] . Plausibility, correctness, propagation and contamination also have established analyses [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 40 , 41 , 32 , 42 ] . Our bounded dependency analysis and counterexamples establish neither a new provenance format nor superiority to these systems. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有审计审查模拟,重播和相位完整性[19,33,34,38,37],试写频率[20],核查限制[26],利用[28,27],补丁 - 发布对齐[51],试探有效性/检测[52]和放大[55]. 透明度、正确性、传播和污染也进行了分析[29、30、31、40、41、32、42]。 我们的有限依赖性分析和反例既不确定新的来源形式,也不确定这些系统的优越性。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: IX Implications and limitations
blocks.zh: 九. 影响和限制

blocks.en: Evidence concerns an operation under stated source, context and lifetime conditions. Startup substitution changes context; cleanup and live flushing concern different intervals. Qualify both the actual default editor and protected checker.
blocks.zh: 证据涉及在所述来源、背景和寿命条件下的行动。 启动替换改变上下文;清理和现场冲洗涉及不同的间隔. 对实际默认编辑器和保护的检查器都进行资格验证.

blocks.en: Selection limits external validity: 118 original episodes cover 31 mechanism-relevant tasks and two model families; later Java/Rust studies reuse 12 development tasks. Handoff and C++ cases are neither representative nor necessarily pretraining-clean. Most later generated-note comparisons use Qwen; an exposed-task Devstral repeat also finds no full repair. Repeated seeds, inputs and library interventions remain within-task observations.
blocks.zh: 选择限制外部有效性:118首原集涵盖31个机制相关任务和两个模型家族;后Java/Rust研究再利用12个开发任务. Handoff和C++案件既不具有代表性,也不一定是预训性清理。 大多数后来生成的音符比较使用Quen;一个曝光任务Devstral重复也发现没有完全修复. 重复的种子、投入和图书馆干预仍然是任务范围内的观察。

blocks.en: Many diagnoses/consumers are source-informed and post-hoc. Polling schedules are constructed, annotations use an application contract, and optional metadata lacks deployment support. Ordinary checks already detect all 12 H/I failures. Finite contrasts establish neither prevalence, diagnosis-time savings nor general repair superiority. A 26-call, one-revision Skill prediction probe initially worsens predictions 9/9 to 5/9; final-JSON-only scoring reverses its overall comparison. The supplement retains representation sensitivity, all failed qualifications and contrary controls. No deployed-folding or general evolution benefit follows. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 许多诊断/消费者都是知情的,而且是事后的。 投票时间表是构建的,说明使用应用程序合同,可选元数据缺乏部署支持. 普通检查已经发现所有12个H/I故障 有限的对比既不能确定流行程度、诊断时间的节省,也不能确定一般的修复优势。 26调式,一改式的技能预测探测器最初使预测的9/9至5/9恶化;最终-JSON只得分则逆转其总体对比. 该补编保留了代表性敏感性、所有失败的资格和相反的控制。 其后没有部署重叠或一般演变效益。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: X Conclusion
blocks.zh: 十. 结论

blocks.en: Correct finite judgments can coexist with incorrect facts or excessive completion claims. Our contrasts locate how production edits change reachability, witness production and consumption; the Rust replay additionally separates registered work from admission in progress. Local repair differences do not establish diagnostic superiority, deployed-folding or general evolution gains. Bind claims to executed operations and intervals, verify evidence consumption, and assess repairs separately from their explanations. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 正确的有限判决可以与不正确的事实或过多的完工要求共存。 我们的对比点是,生产编辑如何改变可及性、目击生产和消费;Rust再次将登记的工作与正在录取的工作区分开来。 局部修补差异不能确定诊断优越性,部署叠加或一般演化增益. 捆绑索赔涉及已执行的作业和间隔,核实证据消耗,评估修理情况与解释分开。 起草协助:OpenAI Codex [50].

blocks.en: Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 可复制性

blocks.en: Research archives retain inputs, outcomes, failures, recoveries and score/cost auditors for 118 original endpoints/860 calls and later cohorts. Their README maps denominators and verification commands. The experimental archive is currently maintained privately; public release is planned. Weights, runtime binaries and dependencies must be obtained separately to regenerate inference. Drafting assistance: OpenAI Codex [ 50 ] .
